cbv16:0.1: Safeguard through the Top of a Banner
cbv16:2.1: By the recollection of that (safeguard) living creatures in the firmament
cbv16:2.2: obtain complete support, just like (living creatures) everywhere on earth.
cbv16:2.3: From the net of all adversity arising from yakkhas, thieves, and rivals,
cbv16:2.4: those who were released cannot be numbered, we will recite that safeguard.
cbv16:5.1: at one time the Fortunate One was dwelling near Sāvatthī
cbv16:5.2: at Anāthapiṇḍika’s grounds in Jeta’s Wood.
